name: Send: his 03 · preview, in Revolut's language
title: Preview

catalogue.note: Not read from Figma: built in code as a twin of send-new-03 (node 38:47544, 375×800), the same screen dressed in the language measured off the Revolut transfer rebuilds (revolut-transfer-01 to 06, 390×844). Everything on it is Mara’s data — the recipient, the phone number, the amount, the fee, the total, the note, the Send label — and nothing on it is Mara’s styling: black ground, #161618 cards with 24px corners inside 16px margins, 37.67px rows with a 500 grey (#A5A5A6) label and a 400 white value, the 41px/700 amount centred 37px under a 44px nav with a glassy 44px back circle and a centred 16.75px/600 title, a muted note line over the 52px white pill 42px off the bottom. Revolut’s numbers were kept as measured in a 390-wide frame and placed in Mara’s 375-wide one. The recipient’s photo became initials in a 42.67px grey circle; the orange check went, because the review card carries no mark for a recipient that is fine; the picture at the left is a render of this build, not a design. Type is IBM Plex Sans, the owner’s choice for Mara, embedded from the Confirmo screens (400, 500, 600, 700, naira sign included). No Revolut text, logo or wordmark anywhere; the status-bar glyphs and the back arrow are the generic iOS shapes.
